name: omero-social-post
description: Open-source, self-hosted social media publisher: compose, schedule and publish to X and LinkedIn from your own server.

scripts.generate: pnpm --filter @omero/shared build && pnpm --filter @omero/api generate && pnpm --filter @omero/api-client generate && pnpm --filter @omero/api-client build
scripts.prepare: lefthook install || echo "lefthook: git hooks were not installed (run 'pnpm exec lefthook install' inside a git checkout)"
